status_note: Launch card written 2026-10-24. Conditional: runs only if research/pkm_m3_specialise_20261024/ (workstream E) does not already decide H0. Also blocked on a 256 GB host, a 512 GB host, and the N = 27 system, none yet named or generated.
blocked_on: note:activation gate: research/pkm_m3_specialise_20261024/ (workstream E) must not already decide H0; not on origin/main at writing
hw:a 256 GB host for the N = 21 target 1 run (RESULTS.md Amendment A1 next step)

links.lead: docs/ic/factor-base-encyclopedia/README.md section 8 item 1 (is the tower's F4 solving degree bounded?)
notes: backlog/XP-20261015-pkm-m3-n21-m4-n20/ (seed card, same question; not superseded by this card)

question: At m = 3, does the Kummer-tower F4 solving degree stay at 7 at N = 21, 24 and 27, or does it rise to 8 or more?
decision_value: A rise to degree 8 or more at N = 21 or 24 extends the m = 4 negative (D >= 8 at N = 20) to m = 3 and counts against H1 for m = 3 at these sizes; a plateau at degree 7 through N = 27 is the H1a precondition (L > 10). Both outcomes change whether the 256 to 512 GB spend is worth making, which is why the run is gated on workstream E first.

build: v0.6.5 (external, built from source; version pinned per RESULTS.md)

resources.notes: msolve -t 16 (16 threads). RAM 512 is the top of the requested range (256 to 512 GB); the 256 GB host covers N = 21 target 1 only. Disk 50 is an ESTIMATE. Core-hours and wall are null: per-round times in reports/run-20261018T2208Z-mt/ not yet read.

outputs.result_schema: msolve per-round log (degree, pairs selected, new elements, matrix size, peak RSS) with the outcome class from README.md

cairn.notes: Four shards, one per system. Gated on workstream E. The N = 27 system is a placeholder until generated. The verify argv re-runs msolve single-threaded and is a placeholder check, not an independent verifier; the independent check is open.

exec.sandbox_reason: msolve working sets of 100 to 480 GB; a jail memory limit would read as an infrastructure error.

funding.rationale: Same question and funding as the seed PKM lead (1,000,000); this card is the large-memory execution of it. The owner should decide whether it supersedes XP-20261015-pkm-m3-n21-m4-n20 for the m = 3 half.

owner_hint: Whoever holds a 256 to 512 GB host.
